vulnerability.explanation: Reads a 32-bit word from contents + (rel->r_vaddr - input_section->vma) without validating that this offset lies within the section buffer. In other relocation paths (e.g., later at lines 1607-1611) bounds are checked, but this BL fixup path omits the check, allowing a crafted object with an out-of-range r_vaddr to trigger an out-of-bounds read.
